user.title: Pair with Breadsheet
user.description: Get a pairing code from your profile on breadsheet.com ({profile_url}). Codes work once, for ten minutes.

data_description.pairing_code: Eight characters, shown as XXXX-XXXX. Case and the dash don't matter.

reauth_confirm.title: Pair with Breadsheet again
reauth_confirm.description: Home Assistant's connection to {username} on breadsheet.com stopped working, probably because it was removed from the profile page. Sign in as {username} and get a new pairing code from your profile ({profile_url}).

data_description.pairing_code: Eight characters, shown as XXXX-XXXX. Case and the dash don't matter.

error.invalid_code: That pairing code is wrong or has expired. Get a new one from your breadsheet profile.
error.rate_limited: Too many pairing attempts from this network. Wait 15 minutes and try again.
error.cannot_connect: Couldn't reach breadsheet.com. Check your internet connection and try again.
error.unknown: Something unexpected went wrong. Try again with a new pairing code.

abort.already_configured: This breadsheet account is already set up in Home Assistant. Pairing it again added an extra connection; remove it from your profile ({profile_url}).
abort.wrong_account: That pairing code belongs to a different breadsheet account. Sign in as {username}, get a new code, and try again. Pairing also added a connection to the other account; remove it from that account's profile ({profile_url}).

token_revoked.message: Breadsheet no longer accepts this Home Assistant's connection. It was probably removed from your breadsheet profile; pair again to reconnect.

unknown_bake.message: No active Fancy bake has the ID {bake_id}. It may have ended.

data.lead_minutes: Minutes of warning before each step

data_description.lead_minutes: When the breadsheet_step_upcoming event fires, before each step is due. 0 turns it off.

complete_step.name: Complete step
complete_step.description: Checks off a step of an active Fancy bake now. The schedule updates at once; if breadsheet can't be reached, the check-off is saved and sent later with its original time.

bake_id.name: Bake ID
bake_id.description: The bake, as in the step events' bake_id or a bake sensor's bake_id attribute.

position.name: Step
position.description: The step's position in the bake, from 1.
